name: CRT Filter
author: Dan Expo
description: A system-wide CRT filter for Hyprland: energy-conserving scanlines, phosphor mask, halation, afterglow and curved glass. Lite mode uses Hyprland's screen shader and needs no build; full mode is a Hyprland plugin built on this machine.

barWidget.description: Toggle the CRT filter, pick a preset, tune the six knobs
